Run this from the project directory:

```bash
npx hyperframes timeline --json
```

This is the right command because nested rows carry absolute main-timeline `absStart`/`absEnd` plus their owning `file`, so you don't have to read `index.html` and each sub-composition file and add the offsets yourself.

1. **Filter by absolute time, not local time.** Look for the rows where `absStart <= 14 < absEnd`.
